rows.title: The live animals list is reframed in place, scoped to the trader's organisation, and plants' list takes the same frame
rows.detail: The live animals notification list stays at the live-animals set root in the animals frontend and is reframed there: a 'Dashboard' browser title and caption, the category as the heading, a primary 'Create new' button straight under the heading, the cards under 'Notifications' and each card named for assistive technology. The list shows every notification of the signed-in trader's organisation, so a trader who signs in afresh still sees their earlier notifications. Plants' own list takes the same frame in the same increment and keeps its own first question. Every new string has a Welsh version.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in trader opening the live animals list sees the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Live animals'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-024; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-023; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-003, repo-frontend-p4-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-086)

A signed-in trader opening plants' notification list sees the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Plants'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-003, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Each card on the live animals list and on plants' list has the accessible name 'Notification <reference>' and the reference as its h3. rows.gate: Look at the reframed frame on both lists (title, caption, heading, 'Create new', 'Notifications', card names) and the organisation-scoped list before the card, tab, search, filter, paging and germinal list rows copy them.
openQuestions: What plants' list heading says, when the frame names the category and the design has no plants list (c-303). Default, which the builder follows and says so: 'Plants', with a Welsh machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off.
notes: Combiner, re-distil 27 November: the k6 journey script's list reads (req-1852) were handed to the split-off manage-notifications branch, which owns that script.

Combines the frame slices of both lists (title and caption, heading, 'Create new', 'Notifications', card names, Welsh) with the organisation scope, because they change the same template, controller and copy of each list's dashboard feature. 'Create new' keeps today's form post: the set the button belongs to carries the category, and where it points is the frontend's to name (c-251); the category stored on the record is the category-on-create row. Each Welsh string is a machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off under the Welsh Language Standards; record it as such in the copy. The animals backend already refuses a list call with no organisation header (its trader organisation header filter), so the scope change is the frontend's list read, which today narrows to the session's own journeys; plants' list stays session-scoped (c-300). The k6 journey's list reads (req-1852) live in perftests src/k6/journeys.js, which theme manage-notifications owns, so that requirement is split off to it. The delete and cancel-amendment breadcrumbs keep the shared 'Your notifications' label: only the list's own h2 changes. Under c-496's default the germinal products list copy takes the same frame in the same increment once it exists (see the germinal list row).
Stands alone from inc-135, inc-138 and inc-141: it carries the plants heading open question those rows do not (inc-135 carries different questions of its own).
Stands alone from inc-136 and inc-137: too much for one plan, the merged row would carry more than about 15 criteria.

Re-distil 27 November, second pass: c-496 is now ruled (27 November ruling, point 10): each row that reframes the live animals list also changes the germinal products list copy in the same increment, so the two animals lists stay copies. The germinal list does not exist until the germinal-products theme's list row lands, and that theme waits on this one, so the germinal share of this row's change is built by the germinal reframe row (inc-172), which lands after it; if the combiner lets the germinal list land first, this row takes its germinal criterion instead and adds frontend:src/server/app/sets/germinal-products/journeys/linear/features/dashboard to its touches.

rows.title: The deletion message reads 'Notification has been deleted.' on the live animals and plants notification lists
rows.detail: After a delete the trader lands on the set's own notification list, whose address marks the deletion so the list shows the message straight away. That address carries no reference, so the list does not know which notification was deleted, and the message names none. The wording goes in each frontend's own list copy, with a Welsh draft beside it, and the shared action wording other pages use stays as it is. Once this lands both the live animals list and the high-risk plants list show the new message after a delete, and the end-to-end suite proves it on each.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleting a notification from the live animals list, the list shows a success notification banner with the role alert, titled 'Success', carrying the delete's message. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-020; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-066; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-099; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-093)

In the high-risk plants frontend, after 'Yes, delete' on a plants notification's delete page, the trader lands on plants' list, which shows a success notification banner with the role alert, titled 'Success', reading 'Notification has been deleted.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-217; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-034, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-069, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-079, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-078; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-070, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101)

A draft's status is a 'Draft' tag in a colour other than the blue of the 'Submitted' tag, a submitted notification's status is the default blue 'Submitted' tag, and a notification being amended shows a yellow 'Amend' tag, on the live animals card and on plants' card. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-062, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-121; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-050, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-054; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-025; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090)

rows.title: The live animals list has 'Submitted', 'Draft and Amend' and 'Past' tabs
rows.detail: The live animals list groups its notifications into three tabs built as sub navigation links, each counted where the design counts it and each with its own subheading and description. The animals backend's list filters by category and tab and reports the counts the tabs show.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows the tabs 'Submitted', 'Draft and Amend' and 'Past' as sub navigation links, each loading the list with that tab chosen; with no tab chosen, or an unknown one, 'Submitted' is chosen, and following a tab clears the search, sort and filters. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-117; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

The 'Submitted' tab lists submitted notifications, the 'Draft and Amend' tab lists drafts and notifications being amended, and the 'Past' tab lists completed notifications. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-118, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-120)

A notification being amended is listed in the 'Draft and Amend' tab with a yellow 'Amend' tag and the actions Resume, 'Copy as new', 'Cancel amendment' and Delete. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-124)

The 'Submitted' and 'Draft and Amend' tabs show their counts in bold brackets, such as 'Submitted (2)' and 'Draft and Amend (3)'; 'Past' shows no count, even when chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-117)

Under the tabs the cards sit under an h3 naming the tab, 'Submitted notifications', 'Draft notifications' or 'Past notifications', followed by its description: 'Notifications you have submitted. You can still change them and add documents.', 'Notifications you have started but not submitted, and notifications that are being amended.' or 'Notifications that have been processed. They move here 2 weeks after the commodity arrival date.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-119)

The animals backend's list filters by category (live animals or germinal products, a record with no category counting as live animals) and by tab, and reports how many notifications the 'Submitted' and 'Draft and Amend' tabs each hold. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)
openQuestions: Which words and grouping the tabs use (c-497). Default, which the builder follows and says so: 'Submitted', 'Draft and Amend' (drafts and notifications being amended) and 'Past', counts on the first two, the subheadings and descriptions above, and the tabs built as sub navigation links.

What puts a notification in the 'Past' tab (c-498). Default, which the builder follows and says so: completed notifications only, so the tab stays empty until a real source of completion exists; the description is shown as the design words it.
notes: Every requirement here is a question with a default, so it is not on the area's to-build list; it is drafted so the tabs keep their row. Stands apart from the search and filter rows because it carries c-497 and c-498, which they rest on. The tab parameter's name and values are the animals frontend's to name (c-251). Under c-496's default the germinal products list copy takes the tabs in the same increment once it exists.
Stands alone from inc-136, inc-137, inc-138 and inc-141: it carries open questions those rows do not (inc-137 carries a different one of its own).

Re-distil 27 November, second pass: c-496 is now ruled (27 November ruling, point 10): each row that reframes the live animals list also changes the germinal products list copy in the same increment, so the two animals lists stay copies. The germinal list does not exist until the germinal-products theme's list row lands, and that theme waits on this one, so the germinal share of this row's change is built by the germinal reframe row (inc-172), which lands after it; if the combiner lets the germinal list land first, this row takes its germinal criterion instead and adds frontend:src/server/app/sets/germinal-products/journeys/linear/features/dashboard to its touches.

rows.title: The live animals list's search and sort become one form that really searches and sorts
rows.detail: The search and the sort move into one column above the cards and become one form to the list's own address. The search finds notifications by reference, commodity, consignee or consignor, and the list is always sorted by one of three orders. The animals backend's list takes the search text and the new sorts, and breaks ties so paging never repeats or skips a notification. Plants' list takes the one-column layout now; its own search and sort wait for the plants backend.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list, inside the 'Notifications' section, the search, then the sort, then 'Additional filters', then the tabs sit in one column above the cards; on plants' list the search and the sort sit in one column above the cards. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-026; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-028; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-013; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-009, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-092, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

The live animals list's search field is labelled 'Search by' with the hint 'Keyword, notification number, commodity, consignee or consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-028; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-005)

The search is submitted by a submit button that shows only a magnifying-glass icon and has the accessible name 'Search'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-006; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-097)

Searching the live animals list for part of a notification's reference number, commodity name, consignee name or consignor name, in any case, lists every notification of the trader's organisation that contains it, and a complete reference lists that notification. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-019, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-022; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-085, repo-tests-p3-089; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010)

The animals backend's list takes a search text and returns, paged, every notification of the caller's organisation whose reference number, commodity, consignee or consignor contains it, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-016, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-017, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-021; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-024)

The live animals list's sort select is labelled 'Sort by:' and offers exactly 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', in that order. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-043, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-046; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-022)

'Newest first' and 'Oldest first' order the cards by when each notification was created, 'Arrival date' orders them by arrival date newest first, and with no sort chosen the cards are in arrival date order newest first with 'Arrival date' selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-047, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-047; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-031; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-098)

The search and the sort are one GET form to the list's own address: the search button submits both, with the chosen tab when it is not the default and the current page when it is above 1, so the result stays on that tab; changing the sort select submits nothing by itself, and the chosen sort stays selected after the page reloads. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-026, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-107; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-030, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-033, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-034, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-036)

The animals backend's list sorts by creation date newest first or oldest first and by arrival date, defaults to arrival date newest first, and orders notifications with the same date by a second key, so walking every page lists each notification exactly once. (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-092; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-057; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-031, repo-frontend-p4-033; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-091)

notes: Combines the layout, search, sort and one-form slices with the backend's search and sort, because they share the one form, the list read and the backend query. The search, sort and filters apply for real on the server (c-162); the list is always sorted, with no unselected option (c-161); the toolbox components are the GOV.UK and MoJ ones, with no custom JavaScript (c-299). 'Apply filters' joins the form in the filters row. The k6 journey (theme manage-notifications' src/k6/journeys.js) searches the list with ?referenceNumber=<id> and checks the reference is on the page: keep that query answering, or tell that branch the new parameter in the handover. The list endpoint and its query sit in manage-notifications' and overview-and-review's files; this theme lands after both. Plants' own search, sort and 'Update sort' stay until the plants backend can query them (the blocked plants row). Depends on the tabs row because the form carries the chosen tab.
Stands alone from inc-137: too much for one plan, the merged row would carry 20 criteria.
Stands alone from inc-138: inc-138 waits on inc-137, whose open question would then hold this row, and inc-137 waits on this row.

rows.title: The live animals list has 'Additional filters' for arrival date, date range and status
rows.detail: Inside the one search form, an 'Additional filters' disclosure offers an arrival-date choice, a date range with date pickers and a status select, applied with an 'Apply filters' button. A date that cannot be read is shown back as an error. A status filter shows every matching notification across the tabs, with a count, and a link clears the filters. The animals backend's list filters by status and arrival-date range.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list's search form holds an 'Additional filters' details disclosure, closed on load and open whenever an arrival-date, date-range or status filter is set. (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-008, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-013; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-108; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-033, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-066; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

The filters have a 'By arrival date' column of small radios 'Today', 'Tomorrow' and 'Next 7 days', whose visually hidden legend repeats the column's heading; choosing one and applying the filters lists only notifications arriving in that range, and the choice stays checked. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-041; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-034; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-001, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-003)

The filters have a 'By date range' column with the hint 'For example, 27/3/2026' and two date pickers, 'Start date' and 'End date', each with a 'Choose date' calendar that opens on the current month with weeks starting on Monday, and each a plain text field without JavaScript. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-031, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-032; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-035, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-036; ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-037, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-038)

Applying a start and an end date lists only notifications arriving between them, and the entered dates stay in the pickers. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-032; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-005, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-006; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-039)

A start or end date that cannot be read as a date, or an end date before the start date, shows an error summary and an inline error on that date field reading 'Enter a real start date', 'Enter a real end date' or 'End date must be the same as or after the start date'; 'Additional filters' is open, the pickers keep the entered text, and the list shows the notifications matching every other filter. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-002, ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-003, ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-019; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010)

The filters have a 'Status' select offering 'All statuses' (selected by default), 'Draft', 'Amend', 'Submitted' and 'Past'; choosing one and applying the filters lists only drafts not being amended, notifications being amended, submitted notifications or completed notifications, and the choice stays selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-110; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

The filters end with an 'Apply filters' submit button, which submits the one search form with the search, the sort and every filter. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-107; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-045; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-039; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-035)

With a status filter set, the list shows no tabs and lists every notification matching the filters, from every tab, under the h3 'Filtered results' with no description beneath it. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-109; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-056; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-061)

With a status filter set and the search field empty, the filtered results show a status line announced to assistive technology, giving the number of matches across every page: 'No notifications match your filters.', '1 notification matches your filters.' or '<n> notifications match your filters.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-112, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-113; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-062, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-063)

The filtered results have a 'Clear filters' link that opens the list keeping only the tab and the sort, and the tabs show again. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-114; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-059; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-067)

The animals backend's list filters by status (drafts not being amended, notifications being amended, submitted or completed) and by an arrival-date range whose from and to dates are each optional. (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-002, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-025, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-028; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-110)

rows.title: The live animals list's Summary shows 'Action needed' and 'Status updated' glance cards
rows.detail: A 'Summary' section above the notifications holds two glance cards, each with a live count for the category and a link to its own filtered list. It waits until the front door's dashboard requirements firm up.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has an h2 'Summary' with two glance cards: 'Action needed' with 'Tasks requiring your attention' and a 'View tasks' link to the action-needed list for live animals, and 'Status updated' with 'Changes in the past 24 hours' and a 'View updates' link to the changes list for live animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-024, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-123; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-027, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-028, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-029; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-026, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-027; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-075, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-099)

The 'Action needed' card shows the number of live animals notifications that need something from the trader, the same number the list its link opens holds. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-078; ruling:sam-2026-11-16 ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-018)
openQuestions: Blocked: the front door's dashboard requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October). Who: Sam and the people those requirements are agreed with. Once they exist this summary information is re-distilled, and what the Summary shows, where its counts come from and which pages its links open are decided then.

Blocked as well for the 'Action needed' count: the outstanding-actions banner the dashboard designs under test introduce must be agreed (Sam, 16 November), because nothing action-required is shown until then. Who: Sam and the designers taking those designs through test.
notes: Kept apart from the rows that build now because both requirements wait on a blocker. The 'Status updated' count waits with the authorities' outcomes row.

rows.title: Cards show the authorities' outcomes: delayed and past notifications, their 'View' action and the status-updated count
rows.detail: Once the authorities' case system sends outcomes back to the notification record, a delayed notification shows an error card with its reason, a finished one a green 'Past' tag in the 'Past' tab, each with a single 'View' link, and the 'Status updated' glance card counts the changes of the past 24 hours.
acceptanceCriteria: A delayed notification's card is an error card with a 'Delayed' tag and the reason for the delay as its message. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-052, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-065)

A notification the authorities have finished with shows a green 'Past' tag and is listed in the 'Past' tab. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-118, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-120, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-121; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-059; ruling:sam-2026-11-16 ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-020)

A delayed or finished notification's card offers a single 'View' link, which opens the notification's review page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-126; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-054; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-088; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-093)

The 'Status updated' glance card shows the number of live animals notifications whose status changed in the past 24 hours, the same number the list its link opens holds. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-029; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-078, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-080)
openQuestions: Blocked: the authorities' case system (PIMS Dynamics) must send post-submission outcomes (inspection required, delayed, completed) back to the notification record. Who: the owners of that integration must provide the outcome feed; until they do, no notification reaches these statuses and none of this can be built or observed.
Blocked as well, for the 'Past' status and its style: a real source of completion must exist (Sam, 16 November). Who: the owners of the authorities' outcome feed.

Blocked as well, for the status-updated count: the front door's dashboard requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October). Who: Sam and the people those requirements are agreed with; the count is re-distilled with the summary information.
Whether the finished status reads 'Past' (c-497) and what the 'Past' tab holds (c-498). Default: 'Past', a green tag, holding completed notifications only.
Whether plants' card follows the 'Past' status is decided when this unblocks.
notes: Kept apart because every requirement here waits on the authorities' outcome feed. The single 'View' covers only the statuses the service does not have yet; drafts, submitted and amending cards keep their status-driven actions (c-160). The 'Inspection required' card is out of scope now, so it leaves this row.

(prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-133; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-062; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-039; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-027)

A germinal products card's 'Quantity (unit/pieces)' is the total of the quantities in units or pieces across the notification's commodity lines, and 'Not applicable' while no line has one. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-070; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

A germinal products card's 'Commodity' is the species, then the product type, separated by a comma, such as 'Cattle, Semen'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-070; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-063)

After deleting a germinal products notification, the germinal products list shows the success notification banner titled 'Success' that the live animals list shows. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-027; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-020)

But the germinal list (inc-141) lives in theme germinal-products, which waits on theme animals-dashboard (inc-176 depends on inc-129, inc-126 and inc-135), so the reframe rows land before any germinal copy exists. Its backend facts (total quantity, species, product type, category) come from the cards row (inc-126, req-1098). The deletion message wording on the germinal list is req-2860, another area's question.

rows.title: Each animals set stores its category on the drafts it creates
rows.detail: The live animals set and the germinal products set each tell the animals backend which category a new draft belongs to, so each list can show only its own notifications. A record with no category still counts as live animals. This is the notification-list area's share of the germinal set's first row.
acceptanceCriteria: A draft the germinal products set creates is stored with the category germinal products, and a draft the live-animals set creates is stored with the category live animals. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-001)
notes: This area's share of inc-176, the germinal set's first row, which already holds req-1856 and req-1857: the combiner merges it there and keeps inc-176's id, theme, gate, dependencies and its criterion on the stored category, taking out any criterion stated twice. That each list then shows only its own category is inc-141's criterion, since the germinal list lands after this row. Neither requirement changed in this pass.
